description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao class which provides data access methods for EmployeeImmigrationRecord entities within the OrangeHRM system. The class includes functions to save, retrieve, delete, and search immigration records related to employees, utilizing Doctrine ORM query builders and supporting pagination and filtering.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling Employee Immigration Records, providing CRUD operations and search capabilities with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: saveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Persists a new or existing EmployeeImmigrationRecord entity, assigning a new recordId if necessary, with validation for recordId range.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Fetches a specific EmployeeImmigrationRecord based on employee number and record ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeImmigrationIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves existing immigration record IDs for a given employee number, filtered by a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeImmigrationRecord entries for a specific employee, identified by a list of record IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordList
methods.description: Returns a list of all immigration records associated with a specific employee, ordered by record number.

methods.name: searchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Performs a filtered, paginated search for immigration records based on provided search parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsPaginator
methods.description: Creates and configures a paginator with filtering and sorting parameters for searching immigration records.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of immigration records matching the search filter criteria.
